zh.title: 桃園機場（TPE）啟動2026年徵才　正取64名、起薪最高65,290元
zh.summary: 桃園國際機場公司啟動2026年新進人員甄試，預計正取64名、備取63名，涵蓋工程、運輸管理及行政管理；通過試用後月起薪43,150至65,290元，其中17個名額不限工作經驗。網路報名至11月2日17時截止。
body: 桃園國際機場公司公布2026年新進從業人員甄試資訊，自10月20日起受理網路報名，預計錄取正取64名、備取63名。此次招募涵蓋工程、運輸管理及行政管理三大類別，為臺灣桃園國際機場（TPE）擴充營運與專業人力；報名期限為11月2日（星期一）下午5時。
依機場公司公布的待遇，各類組人員通過試用後，月起薪介於新臺幣43,150元至65,290元，實際薪資依報考類組及職務而定。招募專業涵蓋土木、建築、機械、環工、資通、航務、營運安全控制、運輸管理、行銷、護理、政風、稽核、會計及一般行政等領域。
本次有17個招募名額不要求工作經驗，為應屆畢業生及準備投入航空產業的求職者提供機會；但報考者仍須符合各類組規定的學歷、英語檢定及其他資格條件。其餘職缺多要求相關專業學歷與工作經驗，部分職務另有專業證照要求，詳細規定以正式甄試簡章為準。
甄試採分階段辦理。網路報名截至11月2日17時，繳費期限為當日24時；第一試筆試訂於11月21日（星期六），第二試面試安排於12月19日至20日，最終錄取結果預定12月30日（星期三）下午2時公告。各類組筆試科目、面試規定及錄取名額，可於招募網站查閱。
機場公司指出，隨第三航廈及第三跑道等重大建設持續推進，機場在工程建設、營運安全、智慧科技與旅客服務等面向均需要專業人才投入。新進人員的工作地點為桃園市大園區的桃園國際機場，招募也反映機場為後續擴建與營運需求提前補充人力。
有意報考者可至甄試專屬網站https://ttia115.twrecruit.com.tw免費下載簡章並線上報名，另可由桃園機場官方招募頁面查詢公告。甄試諮詢電話為（04）2315-2500分機601至603；資格、時程與甄試作業若有異動，均以機場公司及甄試網站最新公告為準。

en.title: Taoyuan Airport (TPE) Opens 2026 Recruitment for 64 Staff Positions, Starting Pay Up to NT$65,290
en.summary: Taoyuan International Airport Corporation is recruiting 64 employees, with 63 alternate candidates, across engineering, transport management and administration. Monthly starting salaries after probation range from NT$43,150 to NT$65,290; 17 positions do not require prior work experience. Online applications close at 5 p.m. Taiwan time on November 2.
body: Taoyuan International Airport Corporation has opened applications for its 2026 recruitment examination, seeking 64 new employees and naming 63 alternate candidates. The intake covers engineering, transport management and administrative roles to support operations at Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (TPE). Online registration began on October 20 and closes at 5 p.m. Taiwan time on Monday, November 2.

According to the airport operator, monthly starting salaries after completion of the probationary period range from NT$43,150 to NT$65,290, depending on the role. Vacancies span civil engineering, architecture, mechanical and environmental engineering, information and communications technology, airside operations, operational safety control, transport management, marketing, nursing, ethics and compliance, auditing, accounting and general administration.

Of the available openings, 17 do not require previous work experience, making them accessible to recent graduates and other first-time applicants to the aviation sector. Candidates must nevertheless meet the educational, English-language testing and any other eligibility requirements for their chosen category. Most other roles require relevant qualifications and experience, and certain positions also require professional certifications.

The selection process includes a written examination on Saturday, November 21, followed by interviews on December 19 and 20. The registration deadline is 5 p.m. on November 2, with payment due by the end of that day. Final results are scheduled for release at 2 p.m. Taiwan time on Wednesday, December 30. Examination subjects, interview conditions and vacancies by category are specified in the official recruitment guide.

The airport company linked the hiring programme to the continuing development of Terminal 3 and the third runway. It said additional expertise is needed in infrastructure, operational safety, smart technologies and passenger services as the airport expands. Successful candidates will work at Taoyuan International Airport in Dayuan District, Taoyuan City.

Applicants can download the recruitment guide free of charge and register online at https://ttia115.twrecruit.com.tw. Official updates are also available through Taoyuan Airport's recruitment page. Enquiries may be directed to +886-4-2315-2500, extensions 601–603. Applicants should check the latest official announcements for any changes to eligibility criteria, examination dates or procedures.
